blocking.title: The peace line (R216) says the peace holds 'even after ten years of peace' days before the war it rules out, and names the wrong rival
blocking.evidence: critic/c90_pw_90441.log, critic/shots/c90pw_90441_d88.png, critic/shots/c90pw_90441_d98.png (two nations: 'Lagunes has no rival within its reach' to day 90, war on Western Australia day 98; critic/c90_reachCase_90441.log: transports at port day 91); critic/c90_pw_89401.log, critic/shots/c90pw_89401_d1595_crop.png, critic/c90_peaceCase_89401.log (a truce of 2 days left unnamed, war on its other party 7 days later); critic/c90_peaceTruth_wars.txt, critic/c90_pt*.log (bash critic/scripts/c90_peaceWars.sh: on 24 seeds, 16 of the 33 wars after a day with reasons came within 30 days, on 11 seeds; SPEC §2 says 'for now' when one may yet declare)
blocking.fix: A realm held off only by a truce that ends or by a lift on order gives no reason ('for now') in every branch of peaceWhy, not only noLift; or the line names that rival and the truce's days left. Seen fixed when c90_peaceWeek.mjs 90441 2 88 98 and 89401 3 1595 1604 show 'for now' or the coming war's rival each day before the war, and on the same 24 seeds (c90_peaceTruth.ts 3 89401 4 10, 3 90411 6 10, 3 90431 8 10, 2 90441 6 10; c90_peaceWars.sh) no war comes within 30 days of a day whose reasons were a truce or 'no rival within its reach'.
